description: This file defines the PatientEditor class, which provides methods for serializing and deserializing Patient objects within the OpenMRS platform. It facilitates conversion between Patient objects and their string representations (by ID and UUID) for web form handling and other data transfer mechanisms.

classes.name: PatientEditor
classes.description: A property editor class for serializing and deserializing Patient objects, extending OpenmrsPropertyEditor to facilitate web form data handling.

methods.name: getObjectById
methods.description: Retrieves a Patient object by its integer ID using the PatientService.

methods.name: getObjectByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a Patient object by its UUID string using the PatientService.
